# `^XG` – Recall Graphic

[Overview](../README.md) · [Libraries](../libraries/README.md) · [Commands](README.md) · [Features](../features/README.md) · [Evidence legend](../METHODOLOGY.md) · [Compare images](../../benchmarks/accuracy/comparisons/README.md)


Recalls one or more stored graphic images for printing. An image can be recalled and resized as many times as needed in each format. Uses magnification factors to scale the image.

Reference parameters: **path, mx, my**. These describe the reference grammar, not a promise that any library honors every parameter. [Zebra guide, page 373](../../zpl-zbi2-pg-en.pdf).
